page.overview:
Who is Jigokukamabuta Megatenpanchiro?

Jigokukamabuta Megatenpanchiro was a retainer of Shimotsuki Family under the Daimyo of Hakumai, Shimotsuki Yasuie.

Megatenpanchiro is a light-skinned man with blonde hair combed into a widow's peak. It has small round eyes and red spiral patterns on its cheeks. He wears a light green kimono and a long sleeveless vest with high shoulder pads, with the Shimotsuki family symbol embroidered on the left side.

Megatenpanchiro took his job seriously and was concerned when Shimotsuki Yasuie chose to give money away to Kouzuki Oden without considering Hakumai's financial situation.

Megatenpanchiro was in charge of accounting for Hakumai's funds.
